summary:
This task adds DiscountAddForm (three numeric fields: min_qty, max_qty, percent) and wires DeleteRowButton into the existing batch_discounts row list inside the single shared DiscountsBlock. `git show 9d05d6a --stat` confirms only client/src/pages/Panel.jsx changed, zero server-side edits. XSS check: confirmed via read of validateDiscountFields (Panel.jsx:292-307) and getDefaultDiscountRange (Panel.jsx:309-317, both pre-existing Task 2 code, unmodified by this diff) that all three fields are numeric — no name/label/free-text field exists on a discount tier, unlike Изделия/Усложнения. Values flow: raw input strings -> validateDiscountFields (rejects non-finite/out-of-range) -> Number(draft.field) -> handleAddDiscount -> settings.batch_discounts array -> rendered back only via SettingsNumberInput's numeric `value={discount.min_qty}` prop (a real DOM property assignment on an ``, not markup) and via the row `key` template literal (keys are never rendered to the DOM as HTML). The only rendered string introduced by this diff is the error message in DiscountAddForm (`

{error}

`), which is `Object.values(errors).join(". ")` where `errors` values are exclusively the three hardcoded Russian literals defined in validateDiscountFields ("«От» должно быть больше 0", "«До» не может быть меньше «От»", "Скидка должна быть от 0 до 100 %") — never user input. Whole-file grep for dangerouslySetInnerHTML/innerHTML/eval/new Function still returns zero matches. Net: no user-controlled string rendering is introduced by this task; the XSS surface present in Tasks 3/4 (typed name -> JSX text child) genuinely does not exist here, confirming the task's own risk framing.
